lessons: storm-producer-wiring Scope in contradicts itself. A binding 'resolved by Box.enqueue at call time' with no constructor argument needs ambient state, but Scope out and Definition of rejected ban an ambient recorder global. Pick one exactly named mechanism.

Take the reviewer's paved road: a contextvars.ContextVar in squatch/box.py, set only inside a context manager returned by daemon.compose_daemon_storm_producer(...) and reset on exit. An explicit per-Box occurrence_recorder= keyword takes precedence.
Reword the ban to cover an unscoped module-global or a permanently installed recorder, not all ambient state. Add a criterion proving the binding is inactive after the scope exits.
The resolution slot must live in box.py or storm.py. daemon.py imports Box, so box.py cannot import daemon without a circular import; daemon owns only the install.
Give compose_daemon_storm_producer its full keyword signature, e.g. (*, state_dir, journal, fs), since install-time reconciliation needs the Box state dir, filesystem and clock.

State whether reconciliation records every missing <box_id>/<n> for n in 1..reports or only the latest, and which ledger timestamp each reconciled occurrence gets. Require tests/test_storm_producer.py to pin that choice.
Update test_seeded_phase3_16 phrase pins to the new wording. Drop 'without editing those construction modules' only if the chosen mechanism no longer supports it.

Keep every earlier fix from the prior lessons. Before finishing, self-run the requisition review on all three authored tickets as well as ticket lint and pytest. Five attempts have passed pytest and failed requisition_review.
reason: Five attempts at medium/medium keep failing requisition_review on under-specified seam design. Each fix introduces a new ambiguity, so more capability is likely needed for a self-consistent design.
